title: Check Tote Task Exchange Type, Priority, Original Destination, and Ready-for-Exchange Status in AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks
summary: Use the AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface to identify the current tote task’s exchange type, priority, original destination, and whether it is marked “ready for exchange,” along with key identifiers (Tote Id, AGV Id, Station, Task id, Task Name) and any Tote Error value.
when_to_use: When you need to verify what exchange type a tote task is performing and whether it is ready for exchange, including the tote/task identifiers and any tote error state, using the live AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks interface.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface and read the tote/task identifiers, exchange-related fields, and Tote Error (if present).
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA HMI (site/customer HMI) access to the “Tote Tasks” / “Tote Task” interface

access_required: AVEVA HMI access to the Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface

visual_references.description: AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface frame showing Tote Task fields (Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, Tote Error) and exchange-related status (exchange type, priority, ready-for-exchange), plus mention of AUV behind it ready to go, stations, and sorter task UID.

steps.title: Open the AVEVA HMI Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface
steps.purpose: Access the live Tote Task view where exchange-related fields and tote/task identifiers are displayed.
steps.instruction: Open the AVEVA HMI screen that shows the “Tote Tasks” / “Tote Task” interface.
steps.expected_result: The AVEVA HMI Tote Task interface is visible and ready for reading the tote/task fields and exchange-related status.
steps.healthy_condition: The Tote Task interface loads with the tote/task field area visible (including the labeled fields referenced in the source).
steps.failure_condition: The Tote Tasks / Tote Task interface does not load or the required field area is not visible.

actions.label: Open Tote Tasks screen
actions.exact_action: Open the AVEVA HMI screen that shows the “Tote Tasks” / “Tote Task” interface.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks screen does not show the required fields (Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, Tote Error), stop and escalate because the required live evidence is not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Nearby text/transcript mentions the Tote Task interface and that it shows exchange type, priority, original destination, ready for exchange, AUV behind it ready to go, stations, and “sorter task UID,” plus tote/task identifiers and Tote Error.

steps.title: Read tote task identifiers and Tote Error from the Tote Task interface
steps.purpose: Capture the exact tote/task identity and any tote error state so support can reference the correct task.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Task interface, locate and read the tote task identifiers/fields: Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, and Tote Error.
steps.expected_result: You have recorded the current values shown for Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, and Tote Error (empty/normal or populated with an error value).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote Error is empty/normal (no error value shown) for the tote task you are investigating.
steps.failure_condition: Tote Error is populated with a non-empty error value for the tote task you are investigating.

actions.label: Read Tote Task fields
actions.exact_action: Locate and read the tote task identifiers/fields shown on the Tote Task interface: Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, and Tote Error.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Tote Error indicates an error for the tote task you are investigating, escalate to FORTNA support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text includes the labeled fields: “Tote Id”, “AGV Id”, “Original Destination”, “Station”, “Task id”, “Task Name”, “Tote Error”. Nearby text/transcript references checking for any error and the tote ID.

steps.title: Check exchange-related fields: exchange type, priority, and ready-for-exchange status
steps.purpose: Determine whether the tote task is performing the expected exchange and whether it is marked ready to exchange.
steps.instruction: On the same Tote Task interface, check the exchange-related fields: exchange type, whether the exchange is marked as priority, and whether it is “ready for exchange.”
steps.expected_result: You have recorded the current exchange type, the priority indicator (priority vs not), and the ready-for-exchange status shown on the Tote Task interface.
steps.healthy_condition: The ready-for-exchange status is consistent with expected operational behavior on the floor (i.e., it is marked ready for exchange when the tote task should be ready).
steps.failure_condition: The ready-for-exchange status does not align with expected operational behavior on the floor.

actions.label: Read exchange status fields
actions.exact_action: Check the exchange-related fields on the same Tote Task interface: exchange type, whether the exchange is marked as priority, and whether it is “ready for exchange.”

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to FORTNA support if the exchange readiness status does not align with the expected operational behavior on the floor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Nearby text/transcript states: “you see what kind of exchange type it's doing, whether it's like the exchange now is like a priority, it's original destination, if it's ready for exchange.”

steps.title: If an AUV behind is ready, confirm stations and sorter task UID association
steps.purpose: Identify which station(s) the tote task is associated with when the interface indicates an AUV behind it is ready, and capture any sorter task UID linkage.
steps.instruction: If the interface indicates an AUV behind it is ready to go, confirm which station(s) are listed for that tote task and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID.”
steps.expected_result: You have recorded the station(s) listed for the tote task and the value (if shown) of the “sorter task UID” association.
steps.healthy_condition: Station(s) and sorter task UID (if present) are visible and can be recorded for the tote task when the AUV-behind-ready indication is shown.
steps.failure_condition: Station(s) or sorter task UID information is not visible when the interface indicates AUV-behind-ready, or the required association cannot be determined from the interface.

actions.label: Confirm station(s) and sorter task UID
actions.exact_action: If the interface indicates an AUV behind it is ready to go, confirm which station(s) are listed for that tote task and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Nearby text/transcript states: “And it means if there's an AUV behind it ready to go, what stations it's at, if it's on the sorter task UID.”

steps.title: Escalate with the exact tote/task identifiers if Tote Error is populated
steps.purpose: Ensure support receives the exact tote/task identity and the specific Tote Error value.
steps.instruction: If Tote Error is populated (non-empty / not “no error”), note the error value and the associated Tote Id / Task Name so support can reference the exact tote task.
steps.expected_result: You have captured Tote Error value along with Tote Id and Task Name for the tote task showing the error.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote Error is empty/normal; no error value needs to be escalated.
steps.failure_condition: Tote Error contains an error value for the tote task you are investigating.

actions.label: Record Tote Error details
actions.exact_action: If Tote Error is populated (non-empty / not “no error”), note the error value and the associated Tote Id / Task Name so support can reference the exact tote task.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to FORTNA support if the Tote Error field indicates an error for the tote task you are investigating.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate failure notes specify escalating when Tote Error indicates an error; OCR/nearby text show Tote Error is a field on the Tote Task interface.

steps.title: Stop after recording the required exchange readiness evidence
steps.purpose: Conclude the diagnostic once the required evidence has been captured.
steps.instruction: Stop when you have recorded the current Tote Id, Task Name, exchange type, priority flag, ready-for-exchange status, Original Destination, Station, and Tote Error (if present).
steps.expected_result: All required items are recorded for the current tote task: Tote Id, Task Name, exchange type, priority flag, ready-for-exchange status, Original Destination, Station, and Tote Error (if present).
steps.healthy_condition: A complete set of exchange-readiness evidence is captured from the AVEVA HMI Tote Task interface.
steps.failure_condition: Any required field is missing from your recorded notes (e.g., exchange type, ready-for-exchange status, or Tote Error when present).

actions.label: Record and stop
actions.exact_action: Stop when you have recorded the current Tote Id, Task Name, exchange type, priority flag, ready-for-exchange status, Original Destination, Station, and Tote Error (if present).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected_result and final stop condition list the required recorded fields.

success_criteria: You can state the current tote task’s exchange type and whether it is marked “ready for exchange.”
You can provide the tote/task identifiers: Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, and Task Name.
You can report Tote Error as empty/normal or provide the exact error value when populated.
healthy_conditions: Tote Error is empty/normal for the tote task being investigated.
Ready-for-exchange status aligns with expected operational behavior on the floor.
failure_conditions: Tote Error is populated with a non-empty error value for the tote task being investigated.
Ready-for-exchange status does not align with expected operational behavior on the floor.
The Tote Tasks screen does not show required fields (Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, Tote Error).
escalation_guidance: Escalate to FORTNA support if the Tote Error field indicates an error for the tote task you are investigating.
Escalate to FORTNA support if the exchange readiness status does not align with expected operational behavior on the floor.

If the Tote Tasks screen does not show the expected fields (Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, Tote Error), stop and escalate because the required live evidence is not visible.
